name: Learning-Space Graphs Are Strictly Contained in Conditional Antimatroids
scope: Finite one-inclusion graphs, up to coordinate reflection.
statement: Every learning-space graph has a conditional-antimatroid orientation, and the inclusion is strict.
proof: Complementing every coordinate of an accessible union-closed learning space gives a convex geometry and hence a conditional antimatroid. The three-leaf star is a conditional antimatroid rooted at its center, but it admits no learning-space root.
